server_description: Start with Bay Run's bounded Guard-first coprocessor; it independently guards user_text and every supplied document even when another Guard or action-safety signal already blocks or escalates, combines document actions as block > escalate > allow, and reranks only after every Guard allows. Use run_pin for a known canonical Pin and solve_task only as the open-ended fallback. A top-level escalate can preserve a signed Guard allow for high-risk action safety or Rerank abstention. Return execution evidence. The coprocessor accepts optional omit_raw_result, which defaults true; set omit_raw_result=false only for an explicit raw-evidence opt-in.
